page.overview:
Who is Balladare Arandaille?

Balladare was elected Amyrlin in, succeeding Edarna Noregovna., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}. She is famous for the consideration that it is the moral duty of the Amyrlin to "explain herself to the common people" once she had made an important decision.

The Kavarthen Wars occurred during her tenure.

She used this to explain her reign during the Kavarthen Wars just before her death. Centuries later Egwene al'Vere quoted this line to Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan.

Balladare is regarded as a weak Amyrlin and died in the series.
